_comment: Issue #421 M4 fixture: the COMBAT half of [Dangersense], which shipped with data pins only and zero live QA. Same pure-Infiltrator-14 build and gear as warded_side_vault_rogue_start (the rogue ladder grants [Dangersense] at L4, so an Infiltrator inherits it -- the script asserts it on the fielded pc rather than trusting this note), standing at (3,12) with the side-vault entrance ALREADY cleared: warded_vault_snare_found / warded_vault_disarmed / warded_side_vault_open are exactly what warded_side_vault_rogue's [Find Trap] -> [Disarm Trap] leg banks. FIXTURE-FIRST on purpose -- that trap route is another canonical's subject and is already pinned there verbatim; this one starts one step from the guard so the fight is the only thing under test. side_vault_construct carries [Slam] (windup_rounds 1), the sole telegraphing family in the game, and its declaration is what the combat overlay reads.
